shell.subtitle: Capability Development
shell.flow: Assess → Prioritize → Develop → Evidence → Feedback → Evolve
prefs.title: Preferences
level.1.description: Knows the main concepts, terminology and purpose of the technology or practice.
level.2.description: Understands the fundamentals and can perform simple tasks with guidance.
level.3.description: Can apply the competency autonomously in real projects.
level.4.description: Makes complex decisions, mentors others and evaluates trade-offs.
level.5.description: Is a subject-matter reference, sets standards and develops other professionals.

dash.lead.allClear.body: No assessment, evidence or PDI is waiting on your decision right now.
help.dash.lead.title: Dashboard
help.dash.lead.what: A snapshot of the team in the active cycle: average levels per capability, assessment coverage, and the biggest gaps.
help.dash.lead.comesFrom: Only COMPLETED assessments feed the map — before that, cells show "—".
help.dash.lead.nextStep: Weak cell? Open Capabilities → Priorities to consolidate it and bring the gap into the person's development plan.
help.dash.member.title: Dashboard
help.dash.member.what: Your cycle at a glance: average level, open gaps, your assessment status, and learning paths.
help.dash.member.comesFrom: From your last completed assessment and your development plan.
help.dash.member.nextStep: Assessment "Not opened"? Go to Assessments and fill in your self-assessment.
help.dashLead.lead.title: Lead Pending Items
help.dashLead.lead.what: The queue of what depends on a decision from you right now: assessments awaiting calibration, evidence to review, and development plans to approve — for your team only.
help.dashLead.lead.comesFrom: From the set of people who have you as their responsible Lead.
help.dashLead.lead.nextStep: Empty queue? Nothing pending right now. Item in the queue? Click it — it takes you straight to the action (calibrate, review, or approve).
help.dashLead.member.title: Lead Pending Items
help.dashLead.member.what: The queue of what depends on a decision from you right now: assessments awaiting calibration, evidence to review, and development plans to approve — for your team only.
help.dashLead.member.comesFrom: From the set of people who have you as their responsible Lead.
help.dashLead.member.nextStep: Empty queue? Nothing pending right now. Item in the queue? Click it — it takes you straight to the action (calibrate, review, or approve).
help.team.lead.title: Team
help.team.lead.what: The roster: who's active, career level, specialization, and gaps per person.
help.team.lead.comesFrom: Average level and gaps come from completed assessments; with none, the row shows "—".
help.team.lead.nextStep: Added someone? Open the cycle assessment in Assessments. Someone leaving? Deactivate with a reason — history stays.
help.team.member.title: Team
help.team.member.what: Who's on the team and each colleague's public profile.
help.team.member.nextStep: Click a name to see their profile and evolution.
help.capabilityMap.lead.title: Who the team depends on
help.capabilityMap.lead.what: Where knowledge is concentrated: how many technical references exist per capability, and where there's a single-person dependency risk.
help.capabilityMap.lead.comesFrom: From the cycle's completed assessments; whoever wasn't assessed shows as "not assessed".
help.capabilityMap.lead.nextStep: Concentration risk? Plan mentoring or a collective learning path in the Training Needs and Mentoring tabs.
help.capabilityMap.member.title: Who the team depends on
help.capabilityMap.member.what: How the team's capabilities are distributed and who the references are.
help.capabilityMap.member.nextStep: Want to become a reference in a capability? Plan it into your development plan.
help.gapAnalysis.lead.title: Development Priorities
help.gapAnalysis.lead.what: Current-vs-expected level radar and the ranking of gaps that block progression or deserve development.
help.gapAnalysis.lead.comesFrom: From the people selected in the filter above; only completed assessments count.
help.gapAnalysis.lead.nextStep: Use "Add to development plan" to turn each gap into an action.
help.gapAnalysis.member.title: Development Priorities
help.gapAnalysis.member.what: The consolidated gaps for the selected scope — yours included.
help.gapAnalysis.member.comesFrom: From comparing your final level to your career level's target.
help.gapAnalysis.member.nextStep: Check your development plan and prioritize the blocking items.
help.progression.lead.title: Team Progression
help.progression.lead.what: A person × capability heatmap and the consolidated gap table — the view for promotion and staffing decisions.
help.progression.lead.comesFrom: Completed assessments for the active cycle, within the filter scope.
help.progression.lead.nextStep: Export CSV/PDF for the committee, or open the Comparison to see 2-6 people side by side.
help.progression.member.title: Team Progression
help.progression.member.what: The team's progression this cycle — your row included.
help.progression.member.nextStep: Check the Progression Policy for the next level's eligibility criteria.
help.trainingNeeds.lead.title: Team Training Needs
help.trainingNeeds.lead.what: Gaps that repeat across 3+ people — candidates for collective training instead of individual action.
help.trainingNeeds.lead.comesFrom: From aggregating the individual gaps of the team visible to you.
help.trainingNeeds.lead.nextStep: Click "Create collective path" — the path is born assigned to everyone with that gap.
help.trainingNeeds.member.title: Team Training Needs
help.trainingNeeds.member.what: Training that leadership is prioritizing for the group.
help.trainingNeeds.member.comesFrom: From the sum of the team's gaps.
help.trainingNeeds.member.nextStep: If a collective path includes you, it shows up in Learning Paths.
help.compare.lead.title: Professionals Comparison
help.compare.lead.what: 2 to 6 people side by side, as an overlaid radar or as a table — support for calibration and promotion decisions.
help.compare.lead.comesFrom: Completed assessments for each selected person; nothing here changes scores.
help.compare.lead.nextStep: Decision made? Record the level change in Team (transition button, with a reason).
help.compare.member.title: Professionals Comparison
help.compare.member.nextStep: Compare yourself with a technical reference to guide your development plan.
help.assessments.lead.title: Competency Assessment
help.assessments.lead.what: The cycle's assessment: the architect's self-assessment, your Tech Lead score, the role's target, and the agreed final score, per competency.
help.assessments.lead.comesFrom: The target comes from the Team Rule; the portfolio defines which capabilities count toward progression.
help.assessments.lead.nextStep: After the architect submits, calibrate the scores and complete it — the final score then applies on the Dashboard.
help.assessments.member.title: Competency Assessment
help.assessments.member.what: Your cycle assessment: propose the portfolio (min. 3 capabilities) and fill in your self-assessment.
help.assessments.member.comesFrom: The targets for your career level come from the Team Rule; accepted evidence shows up as context.
help.assessments.member.nextStep: Fill everything in and click "Submit for review" — after that, only the Tech Lead can edit it.
help.developmentPlans.lead.title: Development Plan
help.developmentPlans.lead.what: The person's development plan for the cycle: actions per competency with type, deadline, and dedication.
help.developmentPlans.lead.comesFrom: Each item is born from an official assessment GAP — the suggestions alongside list gaps still without an action.
help.developmentPlans.lead.nextStep: Approve the plan while it's a draft; follow up through check-ins and complete it at the end of the cycle.
help.developmentPlans.member.title: Development Plan
help.developmentPlans.member.what: Your development plan: what you agreed to develop this cycle.
help.developmentPlans.member.comesFrom: From the gaps in your completed assessment.
help.developmentPlans.member.nextStep: Write the SMART goal, update the actions' status, and log check-ins.
help.learningPaths.lead.title: Learning Paths
help.learningPaths.lead.what: Catalog of paths (courses, labs, projects) with progress per assigned person.
help.learningPaths.lead.comesFrom: Created here by leadership or generated from Training Needs.
help.learningPaths.lead.nextStep: Assign people and track the % — a stalled path is a mentoring topic.
help.learningPaths.member.title: Learning Paths
help.learningPaths.member.what: Your paths and each item's progress.
help.learningPaths.member.comesFrom: Assignments made by leadership (or collective paths).
help.learningPaths.member.nextStep: Update your progress — completed items naturally become evidence on your profile.
help.mentoring.lead.title: Mentoring
help.mentoring.lead.what: Individual session log: topic, notes, decisions, actions, and observed evolution.
help.mentoring.lead.comesFrom: You log it after each session; competencies marked connect the session to the catalog.
help.mentoring.lead.nextStep: Action tied to an assessed gap? Use "Create development plan action" to close the loop.
help.mentoring.member.title: Mentoring
help.mentoring.member.what: The timeline of your mentoring sessions.
help.mentoring.member.nextStep: Review the agreed actions before the scheduled follow-up.
help.competencyMatrix.lead.title: Competency Matrix
help.competencyMatrix.lead.what: The master catalog: capabilities and the competencies of each one (max. 6 per capability).
help.competencyMatrix.lead.comesFrom: Administrative curation; a "Ready" capability unlocks use in a portfolio.
help.competencyMatrix.lead.nextStep: Catalog curated? Each team defines in the Team Rule what it requires of each competency.
help.competencyMatrix.member.title: Competency Matrix
help.competencyMatrix.member.what: The master catalog: capabilities and the competencies of each one (max. 6 per capability).
help.competencyMatrix.member.comesFrom: Administrative curation; a "Ready" capability unlocks use in a portfolio.
help.competencyMatrix.member.nextStep: Catalog curated? Each team defines in the Team Rule what it requires of each competency.
help.cycles.lead.title: Development Cycles
help.cycles.lead.what: Half-year periods that group assessment and development plan; one active cycle at a time.
help.cycles.lead.comesFrom: Created here; activating a cycle closes the previous one.
help.cycles.lead.nextStep: New cycle activated? Open the team's assessments in Assessments.
help.cycles.member.title: Development Cycles
help.cycles.member.what: Cycle history and level evolution between them.
help.cycles.member.comesFrom: Your completed assessments in each cycle.
help.cycles.member.nextStep: Compare your final level between cycles to see your trajectory.
help.settings.lead.title: Progression Policy
help.settings.lead.what: The career ladder: minimum qualified capabilities per level, severity bands, and the model's vocabulary.
help.settings.lead.comesFrom: Policy edited by administrators; the rest is read-only reference.
help.settings.lead.nextStep: Changed the minimum? It applies to eligibility calculated on upcoming assessments.
help.settings.member.title: Progression Policy
help.settings.member.what: The official criterion for your progression and the proficiency scale of the model.
help.settings.member.nextStep: Check Assessments → Portfolio to see how many capabilities you already qualify for.
help.users.lead.title: Users
help.users.lead.what: Access accounts: role (Admin/Tech Lead/Member) and status.
help.users.lead.comesFrom: Accounts created here — the temporary password shows only once.
help.users.lead.nextStep: Created an architect's account? Link it to their record in Team (responsible Lead).
help.users.member.title: Users
help.users.member.what: Access accounts: role (Admin/Tech Lead/Member) and status.
help.users.member.comesFrom: Accounts created here — the temporary password shows only once.
help.users.member.nextStep: Created an architect's account? Link it to their record in Team (responsible Lead).
help.architectProfile.lead.title: Architect Profile
help.architectProfile.lead.what: The person's dossier: radar, gaps, assessment history, development plan, learning paths, evidence, and mentoring.
help.architectProfile.lead.comesFrom: Aggregates everything the other screens recorded about them.
help.architectProfile.lead.nextStep: Use "Next steps" at the top — it's the queue of what depends on you.
help.architectProfile.member.title: Architect Profile
help.architectProfile.member.what: Your full dossier (or a colleague's public profile).
help.architectProfile.member.comesFrom: Your assessments, development plan, evidence, and mentoring.
help.architectProfile.member.nextStep: Log evidence — it supports your next calibration.
help.architectEvolution.lead.title: Evolution
help.architectEvolution.lead.what: The person's observed trajectory: levels over time by capability and competency, with source (assessment × mentoring).
help.architectEvolution.lead.comesFrom: Completed assessments + evolution observed in mentoring.
help.architectEvolution.lead.nextStep: Flat line? Revisit the development plan or the mentoring format.
help.architectEvolution.member.title: Evolution
help.architectEvolution.member.what: Your observed trajectory: how your level evolved over time, by capability and competency.
help.architectEvolution.member.comesFrom: Your completed assessments and the evolution observed in your mentoring sessions.
help.architectEvolution.member.nextStep: Flat line? Bring it up in your next mentoring session or revisit your development plan.
